title: The Portrait Gallery
intro: Hundreds of portraits line the walls and every pair of eyes follows you. The curator's vault is hidden behind the largest frame.

objects.label: Weeping Portrait
objects.reward_text: The painted face opens its mouth and shrieks.

objects.label: Velvet Rope
objects.reward_text: The spirit is amused. It whispers: 'Everything in this room is connected. Finish what you started.'

a_portrait: Write the rule as a formula: next = previous + the one before that + a fixed extra.
Check it: 1 + 2 + 2 = 5. Keep going one generation at a time.
Generation 10 = 121 + 74 + 2 = 197. The vault's character number 1 is Z.
b_bust: Try assuming the first speaker is a knight and follow what that forces. If you hit a contradiction, they are a knave.
A statement from a knave must be FALSE. Negate it to learn something certain.
The knights are Brynn, Drusilla, Fenella. The code is BDF. The vault's character number 2 is 2.
c_frame: You need exactly (width) steps right and (height) steps up, in some order.
The number of routes is the number of ways to choose which steps are 'right'.
That is C(8, 3), the number of ways to choose 3 items from 8.
The answer is 56. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are V and 6.
dare_rope: A dare is optional and never needed to leave the floor.
It never costs you anything to skip it.
Do the dare only if you and your team are happy with it.
It never owns part of the vault code. Skip it freely.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Founder's Portrait, Marble Bust, Gilded Frame.
